title: bothriochloa pseudoischaemum
intro: Bothriochloa pseudoischaemum, commonly known as 'Blue Panic Grass', is a species of grass that belongs to the family Poaceae. This plant is used in traditional medicine due to its various health benefits, which include antioxidant, anti-inflammatory, and antimicrobial properties. The therapeutic actions of Bothriochloa pseudoischaemum include treating fever, wounds, and skin conditions, as well as acting as an anti-diarrheal agent. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and alkaloids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
